name: Voxel Coloring
aliases: Photorealistic Scene Reconstruction by Voxel Coloring
definition: A volumetric reconstruction algorithm that uses color consistency to distinguish object surface voxels from background, starting with an opaque volume and carving inconsistent voxels.
summary: Voxel Coloring reconstructs photo-realistic 3D models by assigning colors to voxels consistent with input images, distinguishing itself by using an ordinal visibility constraint for single-scan reconstruction.
